steps.name: bind
steps.note: Positively charged proteins, lactoferrin among them, are bound to the resin at pH 4 to 9; in one example, skimmed milk of pH 6.8 is cycled through it for 3 h.
Nothing is taken off the resin before this.

steps.name: release
steps.note: Lactoperoxidase is released first, in salt at 0.3 to 0.4 molar and pH 4 to 5.

steps.name: release
steps.note: The secretory component is released next, in salt at 0.4 molar and pH 6.5 to 7.

steps.name: release
steps.note: Lactoferrin is released last, in stronger salt: 1 molar, or 0.75 molar at pH 7.5.

links.name: US5516675A, Separation of lactoperoxidase, secretory component and lactoferrin from milk or whey with a cation exchange resin

sources.text: A patent on separating lactoperoxidase and lactoferrin from milk or whey with one cation exchange resin; its skimmed milk example is the basis here. The temperature given is the 15 degrees C or less it prefers for large volumes (4 to below 60 degrees C possible).
